title:
Talk together.
Leave with a plan.
label: ROUNDTABLE AI
body:
A shared decision room
for the whole group
proof: One goal. Every constraint. A visible decision.
narration: Group plans stall when everyone's needs are scattered across a chat. RoundTable AI gives the whole group one shared decision room. Talk together, see the trade-offs, and leave with an approved plan.

title:
Give the conversation
a finish line
label: 01 / CREATE A ROOM
body:
Choose the goal.
Bring your people.
Set a decision rule.
proof: A mobile experience built around group decisions
narration: Start with an outing, choose your crew, and set the room's decision rule. The mobile interface gives every conversation a clear finish line.

title:
Every constraint
stays visible
label: 02 / SHARED SMART STAGE
body:
Budget: under ₹700
Vegetarian food
An evening everyone can make
proof: Participant tiles, captions and agent controls
narration: Ayaan wants to stay under seven hundred rupees. Priya wants vegetarian food. The Smart Stage keeps the room's constraints visible, alongside participant tiles, captions, and controls to pause the agent.

title:
Show the trade-offs.
Make a fair choice.
label: 03 / COMPARE OPTIONS
body:
₹760 bowling: excluded
₹890 painting: excluded
₹620 games café: eligible
proof: The recommendation explains its budget headroom
narration: RoundTable compares three outing options. Two exceed the budget and are excluded. The games cafe costs six hundred and twenty rupees, leaving eighty rupees of headroom. The recommendation explains the trade-off.

title:
Everyone gets
a say
label: 04 / ROOM VOTE
body:
Three participants.
Three recorded votes.
One reviewable outcome.
narration: The room now votes. In this guided demo, we cast each participant's vote. Application state records all three, and the workflow waits for everyone before opening the action review.

title:
Consent before
execution
label: 05 / ACTION REVIEW
body:
Review the plan.
See who is affected.
Approve the next step.
proof: The host can return to comparison instead
narration: Before anything happens, the host reviews the plan, time, and attendees. Explicit approval comes first, with a clear path back to comparison.

title:
A decision
with a receipt
label: 06 / VISIBLE OUTCOME
body:
Selected plan
Vote count and approval
A traceable demo receipt
proof: Local demo receipt • external calendar write pending
narration: The approved workflow ends with a visible receipt containing the plan, votes, and approval. This is a local demo receipt; the external calendar provider remains a separate integration.

title:
Plans change.
The room adapts.
label: 07 / CONVERSATION TWISTS
body:
Rain changes plans.
Someone leaves early.
The shared brief changes too.
proof: Three working scenarios in one decision engine
narration: Rain changes the plan. A participant needs to leave early. RoundTable's scenario controls update the shared brief and alternatives, demonstrating the same decision engine under different constraints.

title:
Agora is the
voice foundation
label: AGORA / REAL-TIME ARCHITECTURE
body:
RTC: microphone and agent audio
RTM: transcripts and agent state
Agent Client Toolkit: session lifecycle
proof: Native voice entry wired • live account test pending
narration: Agora is the voice foundation. The native client uses RTC for microphone and agent audio, RTM for transcripts, and the Agent Client Toolkit for conversation state. FastAPI keeps Agora credentials on the server and manages tokens and agent sessions.

title:
One coordinated
voice pipeline
label: AGORA / CONVERSATIONAL AI
body:
Speech recognition → language model
→ speech synthesis
Voice activity detection and interruption
proof: Configured in source • not a live call in this recording
narration: The configured Agora pipeline combines speech recognition, a language model, and speech synthesis, with voice activity detection, interruption settings, metrics, and errors. Android now has a reachable live voice screen. Account and device validation are still pending; this recording demonstrates the complete guided group journey.

title:
The AI serves
the room
label: BUILT BY SHIVAM MAHENDRU
body:
Talk together.
Decide together.
Get it done.
proof: RoundTable AI • Agora Voice AI Hackathon 2026
narration: RoundTable AI turns a group conversation into a visible decision process. The AI serves the room, while people stay in control. Talk together. Decide together. Get it done.
